technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions with strong trend structure create potential reversal setup, but multiple bearish patterns, price below key moving averages, and lack of confirmed entry signals indicate high risk of continued downside.

fundamental.summary: MU shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 68 days adds timing risk.

sentiment.summary: Moderate congressional buying signal from senior member combined with extreme market fear (VIX-like 30 score) and bearish AAII sentiment (46.7%) creates contrarian buy setup, though signal age and lack of recent news limit conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (339.84) dominates risk assessment; normal yield curve provides limited offset; earnings in 68 days adds moderate event risk; macro_score of -1 confirms unfavourable conditions.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme oversold conditions (RSI 9, Stoch, Williams %R) combined with ADX strong trend structure and contrarian congressional buying in fear-zone environment create potential mean-reversion setup.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price below all key moving averages (EMA 9/21/50), three black crows pattern, DC breakout down, MACD bearish histogram, zero active strategy triggers, and crisis-level VIX (339.84) in unfavourable macro environment indicate continued downside risk outweighs oversold bounce potential.
